contract: A worker process holding a workflow task claim is replaced by a new registration of the same worker_id, which releases the lease; the task is claimed again as attempt 2. Requests from the replaced attempt 1 are refused with the published ownership guard bodies a worker reads to recognize a lost claim. While attempt 2 holds the lease, completion and lease renewal are refused with 409 workflow_task_attempt_mismatch and the current attempt. After attempt 2 completes the task while the run is open, completion, renewal and failure are refused with 409 task_not_leased and task_status completed. After the run closes, a late completion is refused with 409 run_closed, can_continue false, the run status and closure, and the completed task, which keeps its lease owner and has no lease expiry. No late request records history; each task records one completion. Embedded applications have no HTTP worker registration.
